findings.claim: The MessagePackSecurity.DepthStep comparison was changed from >= to >, which allows one more level of nesting than MaximumObjectGraphDepth. It is unrelated to REQ-2234 (analyzer with SuppressSourceGeneration) and loosens a security limit. Ledger L9 records the stack depth limit as a deliberate hardening.

receipt_plan.detail: Set MaximumObjectGraphDepth = N, deserialize a payload nested exactly N+1 deep. Base throws InsufficientExecutionStackException; head does not. Also cite [L9]: the depth limit is a recorded security hardening, and nothing in the requirement justifies relaxing it.

findings.claim: The README and tests claim MsgPack011, MsgPack016 and MsgPack017 are not reported for suppressed types, but the visible hunks contain no change that implements this. Only duplicate-key skips were added in TypeCollector. The test SourceGenerationOnlyDiagnosticsAreNotReportedWhenSuppressed may pass or fail depending on code outside the shown scope.

receipt_plan.detail: Run SuppressSourceGenerationAnalyzerTests.SourceGenerationOnlyDiagnosticsAreNotReportedWhenSuppressed on head and on base, and confirm the analyzer code path that gates MsgPack011/016/017 on SuppressSourceGeneration.

findings.claim: The README says MsgPack004 and MsgPack015 apply to suppressed types, consistent with the analyzer rules recorded as Errors/Warnings in the ledger. Because the analyzer is intended to keep validating these types, TypeCollector behaviour for them is not a defect.

receipt_plan.detail: [L3] MsgPack004 requires [Key] or [IgnoreMember]; [L2] severities for MsgPack004/005/015 are Errors/Warnings as documented.

options: Yes, validate the runtime contract but skip generation-only rules (as implemented)
Report all diagnostics, including 011/016/017, as in 3.1.0

interpretations.label: A
interpretations.summary: With SuppressSourceGeneration = true, the analyzer reports runtime-contract diagnostics (003/004/005/012/015) but skips generation-only diagnostics (011/016/017). Implemented by the TypeCollector duplicate-key fixes plus the README and tests.

interpretations.label: B
interpretations.summary: Restore exact 3.1.0 behaviour: report all MsgPack diagnostics, including 011/016/017, for suppressed types. This needs removing the suppression gating for those rules and changing the README and test expectations.
